notes.title: Ship of Heroes is now available!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="K_yCjhdKT4o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is a game with a brand new story not seen anywhere else. Discover the ups and downs of life on a massive generation ship – an entire nation traveling through space. See a unique vision of humanity’s future 500 years from now. Unravel unique mysteries and learn what’s really going on aboard the FHS Justice. Then explore planets, visit alternate dimensions, and more…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/4e5ea465b787b0e1f35f9bcb06af5f3ba1f9ffca.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]This entire city, the main hub of the game, is only one small part of a massive spaceship.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Ours is a vibrant setting, totally unlike the standard of feudal villages, or modern towns on Earth. The ship’s hub area is clean, bright, spacious, and full of cool sights to see. Building interiors are worthy of exploration. Or you can fly around the Hazard Zone and watch the alien plants. It can be fun to just chill and look at the beautiful scenery.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a869ea030c706a247930aada6cf462c7fcc28ac5.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The Hazard Zone lives up to its name, but it's also very pretty.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Just like we promised 7+ years ago, we’ve created the core of a great game, which already has quite a few things to do and powers to try out. We believe that a small, really fun game can be expanded with the same qualities. But a big, boring game is very hard to fix. As you can see in this official launch video, [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] delivers on excitement![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e95a57adc37285cb44411bf982e2a172ade83859.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Nagdellian motherships are strange, dark, and full of hostiles. Be careful.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There are things you can only do in a brand new, growing MMO. Create a massive guild, or become a trusted leader in one. Earn achievements for the first time. Explore places and game mechanics no one has mapped out yet. Define a whole new meta or playstyle. Teach friends the things only you know. Be respected.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/79507d694c90cd06c081f258d1e90e31be6ea1fc.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The trinity works, but teams can also win with powerful buffs, debuffs, mez, and pets.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We're grateful for our great community: their patience, their input in shaping [i]Ship of Heroes[/i], and their financial support. Every bit of it is truly appreciated and has helped make the game what it is today.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our community is positive in part because of SoH's simple monetization: no honing, no premium loot boxes, and no cash shop at all. We’re all equal in the game. All we ask for is an initial purchase and a continuing subscription. The purchase price discourages trolls and spammers, making the game more fun for everyone else. Subscriptions keep the game running for decades. The pattern for many MMOs is to retain only a small fraction of their players after the first month. But [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is a niche game that doesn't need to compete with WoW to be successful – we just need the steady support of our fans. We hope players who like our game will stay and help build the community while we continue to expand and polish the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re designing the game with many, many little subtle things to try to bring a more courteous, a more positive community back. We’re willing to be a smaller game to have a more positive community.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/6525b34e174543a67b4cb7882241aa6f54a294c1.png"][/img][/p][p][i]There's a simple joy in stomping through the snow and leaving tracks behind you.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Playing [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is a lot of fun. You can do everything solo, and only interact when you want to. Or, team up with strangers without fear, and make new friends easily. The game is designed to appeal to and reward positive and helpful players, bringing out the best in everyone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/32f267638f7a42e62e3d69d12013d5ed1d166a94.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Team battles are fast-paced, chaotic, and exciting.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SoH is built to reward long-term play; it’s fun from level one to infinity. After reaching the current max level, you can gain veteran levels with no limit, increasing your max health – but only skillful tactics can increase your damage. As the game grows, we plan to increase the level cap as well, so plenty of excitement awaits you![/p][p][/p][p]Today is just the beginning of the adventure![/p]

notes.title: Ship of Heroes Announces Pricing and Launch Details
notes.notes: [h2][b]Launch date and time[/b][/h2][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] will become available Monday September 22, 2025 at 2:30 PM EST.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Pricing[/b][/h2][p]The initial download and an active subscription will give access to everything in the game. There are no microtransactions, no cash shop, no premium addons, no deluxe launch package. The initial download of $60 plus an active subscription gives access to everything currently in the game and added in the two years after launch. One month access is included in the initial download fee.[/p][p]Once in the game, players can choose their term of subscription:[/p][p]1 month: $15[/p][p]3 months: $42 (Save 7%)[/p][p]6 months: $78 (Save 13%)[/p][p]Yearly: $144 (20%)[/p][p][i]Screenshot[/i][/p][p]Microtransactions on the Steam store page refers only to the subscription, as it is implemented through the Steam microtransaction system. There are no actual microtransactions in [i]Ship of Heroes[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What is included[/b][/h2][p]·       10 character slots[/p][p]·       The full character creator and costume collection[/p][p]·       5 archetypes; 240 powers[/p][p]·       Fast travel powers such as flight[/p][p]·       Missions and raids[/p][p]·       Housing[/p][p]·       2,500 Unobtainium Dust (in game currency) for your first character[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Recommended System Requirements[/b][/h2][p]OS: Windows 10 or 11[/p][p]Processor: Intel core i7-8700 4.60 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 3600[/p][p]Memory: 32 GB RAM[/p][p]Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3000 series or above / AMD Radeon RX 6600 or above[/p][p]DirectX: Version 11[/p][p]Storage: 35 GB available space[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Account Wipe[/b][/h2][p]Characters in existing accounts will be returned to level 1 and their progress will be wiped (missions and achievements). Powers, equipped augments, infusions, inventory items will be removed. So will housing.[/p][p]Character name and appearances will be retained. The appearance of characters created many years ago may have been altered by the many changes to the character creator.[/p][p]You will be able to choose your archetype and starting powers for your existing characters either in the character creator or by visiting a Power Trainer.[/p][p]We are grateful to those who helped us test the game during development. As a thank you, those players will start with the Beta Tester badge.[/p][p][/p][p]For questions, please post on [url="https://ShipofHeroes.com/forum/"]ShipofHeroes.com/forum[/url] or fill a contact form on the website.[/p]

notes.title: Player Housing
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cc04184657721985cbcc9c91686afdbf84bb8c26.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="bYDXfBdFNT8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] has great player housing and superhero lairs! Most MMORPGs have some sort of housing system. If a game is a medieval fantasy, it can be easy for the devs to simply buy some assets and allow a player to put down a house, or take over a section of a dev-built castle. But what about in the future, aboard a prosperous nation-in-space generation ship? Well, we think luxury should be an option. And in the future, nothing screams out “luxury” like beautiful spaces and decorating, plus atavistic features not expected aboard a spaceship like fireplaces, pets, and those oh-so-expensive artifacts from old earth called “books.”[/p][p][/p][p]We’re starting out with ten initial housing models. Some of you will recall that we have previously conducted two open beta tests of our housing system. As a result of those betas we have fixed all known bugs and we’re giving you a bunch of options so that your hero-home aboard the F.H.S. Justice can be completely unique and different compared to every other residence. And feel free to invite your friends to jump into your virtual home and look around. We plan to add supergroup bases after launch, so we can collect thoughts and ideas from the community before we settle on a plan for team locations, but the supergroup bases will be more team and combat-focused than housing. One thing we are considering is allowing your safe personal housing space to have a portal to your supergroup space, which we think would be cool.[/p][p][/p][p]Come see what we’ve built after launch on August 18th. It’s different than most other games. We think you’re going to like it.​[/p][p][/p][h3]Can I have more than one base?[/h3][p][/p][p]Each character can have one of each of the 10 floor plans. For 10 character slots, that is 100 housing units, enough to become a real estate mogul.[/p][p][/p][h3]​How much does it cost? Do I have to pay extra if I want more than one home?[/h3][h3][/h3][p]All housing is included in the monthly subscription. The rent paid in in-game currency is modest and so are the prices of most items.[/p][p][/p][h3]​What happens to my house if I forget to pay the rent?[/h3][p][/p][p]Rent does not renew automatically. If you forget to pay, you can just start paying again to gain access. You do not have to catch up on the missed months.[/p][p][/p][h3]​What do the spaces look like?[/h3][p][/p][p]You can see empty spaces before renting them by selecting the Default Preview option. This option is good for gauging the size and layout of spaces. We anticipate that these empty windowless spaces will not scream “Rent me!”. To provide inspiration, the video shows a selection of furnished spaces, some of which can be visited in game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/4889744578268687b9623d5809dfac3fd0d1fd24.png"][/img][i][b]Studio in preview versus decorated. Slide to see the pictures[/b].[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/69f6a1d17ef42bc60d340d8298f8b43a3822eea7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you visit one of the spaces open to viewing, hovering over objects will show you their name, in case you want to acquire them for your own space.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e5640894e1347d8ebca3509861a3187326ba0083.png"][/img][b][i]What’s that? Find out by hovering over the item.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3]What if I change my mind on the floor plan I picked?[/h3][p][/p][p]No problem. Return the furnishings you had in the home to your inventory and stop paying rent on this unit. That’s it.[/p][p][/p][h3]What if I don’t like the layouts offered?[/h3][p][/p][p]No problem. A variety of architectural elements can be added to reshape your space: partitions, glass walls, section of flooring, stairs….[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/71e76c106706d4e71ab285ae02a79835c3628f9e.png"][/img][b][i]Wall partitions can be edited like any other furnishing[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3]How difficult is it to learn? Is there a housing tutorial?[/h3][p][/p][p]There is no housing tutorial because the system is incredibly intuitive and easy to use. Tooltips on the housing UI buttons indicate what they do. And in case you forget, clicking on the question mark “?” in the housing UI brings up a cheat sheet with all the commands.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/0b14ff3e435f4b03599c5ef430e5d67ac4facfed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What can I customize?[/h3][p][/p][p]Layout, floor, walls and ceiling. Windows and skylights. Doors and portals. Lighting can be colored and dimmed for mood. Furnishings can be resized, stretched and most can be colored.[/p][p][/p][h3]What can I create?[/h3][p][/p][p]It is entirely up to your imagination. In addition to the spaces shown in the video (Weight lifting studio, roof top terrace, night club…), our devs created an airplane maintenance facility, a small military unit base, and multiple homes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/adfd3593b41235133be17682aa61450cf02ba5c0.png"][/img][b][i]Small military unit base[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Can I show off my creation?[/h3][p][/p][p]Absolutely! We hope you do to inspire us all. It is just a matter of switching a toggle by clicking “Access” in the UI. And you can change your mind about this at any time.[/p][p][/p][h1]Technical Notes[/h1][p] [/p][p]•    SoH may be the only MMORPG where you can create a modern, classy dwelling.[/p][p]•    Two new QoL additions help remember which character has which housing units. A “H” on the character list in the character creator marks characters with housing units.[/p][p]•    On the list of housing floor plans, furnished units for which the rent is current are framed in green. We are working on framing in yellow occupied units where the rent is not current.[/p][p]•    Deleting a character deletes its housing instances.[/p][p]•    If your rent is not current, your home stops being available for viewing by others.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ea5f1ceec2e2299617ec558d7799ad1c7c8c9da1.png"][/img][b][i]H marks characters with houses. No more guessing![/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Teaming is Fun and Rewarding
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9046832e805ec75f8297dce265841b3c82b2a4e0.png"][/img][/p][p]Teaming is fun! We’ve incorporated the best suggestions from beta players and the best ideas from other MMORPGs into our team play. The result is very satisfying already, and it’s only going to get better from here.[/p][p][/p][h1]​You’re not forced to join teams[/h1][p][/p][p]Most parts of SoH can be played solo. Right now, the only exceptions are our two large raids. They contain spectacular fights and give good loot, but players who’d rather solo can earn the same items elsewhere. So, when you do join a team, or a raid league, you know that everyone else chose team play over soloing. They aren’t being forced or pressured into it.[/p][p][/p][h1]​Team sizes are flexible up to 10[/h1][p][/p][p]No mission requires a specific team size. Team sizes are flexible up to 10 members. Bigger teams face bigger enemy groups with more elite foes among them. The most challenging battles also scale in this way, rewarding advanced team compositions and tactics, but the default difficulty leaves plenty of room for experimentation.[/p][p][/p][p]Our devs have done a lot of combat balance testing while on teams. There’s always more to improve, but missions like Prize Crew are now quite fun for any team size… and quite challenging, if the team leader turns the difficulty up. Do not expect to succeed on the higher difficulties without dying a bunch![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bf18d8b411be44189aebc3ede39db9a36dc75295.png"][/img][b]Enemies on default settings aren't too bad, though.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Teaming has its benefits[/h1][p][/p][p]It takes time to form a team, and coordination gets harder the bigger the team is. So the total experience, dust, and items earned are modestly increased the larger the team is. The number of team members determining your bonus is shown under your health bar. Mouse over it to see your team boost.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/69bac9cf60eaa8fee57c08f3d59af432f2858eb5.png"][/img][b]It's satisfying to see the number go up as the team grows.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Leaders get extra rewards[/h1][p][/p][p]Team leaders get a slightly larger bonus than team members on the same size of team, but they also have more responsibilities. In raids, the team leaders report to a league leader, who gets another small boost, as thanks for organizing the entire raid. Again, the goal is to balance the reward with the extra effort of managing a group. Leaders can also transfer leadership, set the mission’s difficulty for everyone, kick troublemakers from their team or league, and teleport everyone in the same map to their location to help keep things organized.
Raid leaders get additional extra powers.​[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e3372bd201fc4720c83ae227cce537a1fe04295f.png"][/img][b]"Time to run!"[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]You can team up with anyone thanks to sidekicking and mentoring[/h1][p][/p][p]Team members of different levels are raised or lowered to one level away from the leader, so every player can make a difference. If you are sidekicked, your number of powers does not increase but the powers you do have do more damage.
Team leaders set the mission difficulty for everyone in General Settings. The difficulty level must be set before you enter the instance. This setting adjusts not only the difficulty, but the rewards. Greater challenge, greater rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f2350de94ea3f1b251784f6cff0111b707b83e90.png"][/img][b]Each level of difficulty is a big change.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]​Your reputation matters[/h1][p][/p][p]There’s no matchmaking system in SoH, intentionally. Most teams will be formed by talking in broadcast chat or within your supergroup. This design makes it harder to silently speedrun missions with strangers. It encourages making friends organically by doing missions together. Friendly behavior will give you more people who’ll want to do other missions with you later. The SoH community is amazingly nice and helpful overall.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/71b0c69c5624c5df6d740c6afb72b47639cbb1c2.png"][/img][b]"If Gold is here to tank, we can focus on maximum damage."[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Inviting players to your team[/h1][p][/p][p]There are several ways to invite people to a team:
• You can click the social button under the compass at the top of the screen to see and invite anyone nearby.
• Right-click on a player, or on a targeted player’s portrait in the upper-right, to invite that person.
• For distant players, you can type the chat command /invite with the target’s name instead.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bcb215bb04c8fdd4a20d988fb948e607727f87ee.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The other options are all useful, too.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]A world designed for teaming[/h1][p][/p][p]Ever felt that the rooms were too big when playing solo? Now imagine the same room with 10 players, their pets, and a matching number of enemies. Or better yet, try it. It could be quite crowded.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/7eb12dec8f65a3be0712c33d6668ee38a69c2a5d.png"][/img][/p][p][i]​[/i][b]"You could fit a whole football team in here... and they will, on higher difficulties!"[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Where is the rest of my team?[/h1][p][/p][p]As a team member, you can find your team on the map (Press M) and the minimap; they are the little green dots. But instead of running back to them, you can use the universal power Regroup to teleport back to your team leader.
The team leader also automatically has the Assemble power to gather his or her team to them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/5513ba6e28ff01b23881cccc1372d7ac50772636.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/74a94fbe33d4c7b89e602d1f369b5c24701d3ad4.png"][/img][b]Some universal powers are just for fun, but others are critical.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Different builds and powers are better for solo or for teaming[/h1][p][/p][p]Every possible hero has some ability to fight alone, and some ability to fight on a normal team, but even within the same powersets, some are much better at one playstyle. For example, AoE powers like Fireball and Flash of Insight are very strong on a big team, with many allies to buff or heal and enemies to burn at once. But single-target powers like Plasma Bolt and Jinxed are great in intense solo fights.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9f5aa1afb7018e7835efe5a60892b19dc250af61.jpg"][/img][b]Aiming heals where the team will be in two seconds takes some skill.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]It’s easy to follow the story as a team member[/h1][p][/p][p]Unless you choose to disable voiceover audio, you’ll hear the mission contact’s spoken dialog from anywhere in the game, even if the team leader walks away. In addition, each spoken line is recorded in the special dialog tab of the chat window, so you can read it at any time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1c608b16c8e8f6ac62002d55556a03d4877492d1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Future Developments[/h1][p][/p][p]We hope to add options to directly invite people in your supergroup, the SoH name for guilds, and in your friends list. But for now, the other three methods all work.[/p][p]We also have more QoL improvements queued up for release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/863e15a5015364e2999ef93372b81e3c4b3b1415.png"][/img][/p][p][b]"A glowing enemy? Everyone, use some infusions!"[/b][/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/b659b7952bcaa135c0210397f0512c85c3096dfb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is having a Playtest this weekend to test the server arrangement at different levels of loading. This is a technical test. There will also be an invasion event on Sunday.[/p][h2][b]How to participate[/b][/h2][p][b]New Players[/b][/p][p][url="https://shipofheroes.com/playtest-signup/" style="button"]Sign up early[/url]   to avoid delays.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Donors[/b][/p][p]Donors who are already in the donor beta have access to the playtest. No registration required. Donors who want to participate but have not yet accessed the Donor Beta can either join it or register for the Playtest. Which one is best? To help you choose, consider these differences.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]Playtest[/p][/td][td][p]Donor Beta[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Access Ends[/p][/td][td][p]August 3[/p][/td][td][p]August 17[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Access Guarantied[/p][/td][td][p]No[/p][/td][td][p]Yes[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Additional Content[/p][/td][td][p]None[/p][/td][td][p]Throughout the beta[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][b]Returning Players who are not Donors[/b][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]Yes[/p][/td][td][p]No[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]SoH or SoH Playtest in the Steam Library*[/p][/td][td][p]Access granted for the Playtest duration[/p][/td][td][p]Signup for the Playtest[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p]* You may need to reinstall through Steam[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Invasion Event Sunday at 3:00 PM EST[/b][/h2][p]To test our server setup there will be an invasion event as shown in the image above on Sunday at 3:00PM EST. Even if you do not want to participate, we would appreciate your being in the City just before, during or just after, to maximize the server load and allow us to test scenarios.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Feedback and Bug Report[/b][/h2][p]A feedback and bug report is conveniently accessed in game by clicking the ? on the compass. This is our preferred method as your character, your location in the game, and the time the bug happened, are automatically recorded. This also immediately places the bug or feedback in the “fix” list.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Getting Help[/b][/h2][p]Please contact HeroSupport or reach out through any of the contact forms.[/p][p]Our priority during events is to respond to requests coming to the HeroSupport email or through contact forms. If you think the response will be interesting to other players, you can in addition, post on our forums.[/p][p]Social media is not a good place to seek help as they are only loosely monitored and do not provide enough information to help specific players.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Wishlist![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Wishlists numbers help us size the servers for launch[/b][/p][p]As we are not a major brand name, presales are not available to us on Steam. And while we welcome being pleasantly surprised by unexpected crowds, this would not provide our players with the experience we want to deliver.[/p][p][b]Wishlisting tells Steam that we are worth promoting[/b] [/p][p]As we are a small indie, we have little budget money for promotion. We rely heavily on word of mouth and this free Steam algorithm push is super valuable.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]How you can help[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]> Wishlist Ship of Heroes if you have not already [/p][p]> Tell your guild and your gaming friends about [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] and ask them to wishlist if they are interested [/p][p]> Tell your favorite content creator about us.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Realease Date Announced
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="2VXLjLLkeSU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] will launch on August 18th, 2025 on Steam.  [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is a sci-fi superhero MMORPG for PC where advanced technology and magic interact. It will be available on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]We've come a long way, starting as a small indie team with big dreams. Our vision was to create a new superhero MMORPG, but in a style closer to the golden age of MMOs. One that allows a large numbers of highly customized characters to be on the screen at the same time for raids, costume contests, etc…. And our community wanted a new story with superheroes in an action-packed sci-fi setting. Most of all, people wanted a friendly game where it'd be safe to join teams of total strangers, because they're generally positive and helpful.[/p][p][/p][p]To accomplish these goals, we chose the Unreal 4 engine, and we made countless decisions about graphical quality, textures, [url="https://shipofheroes.com/how-animations-and-fx-make-ship-of-heroes-exciting/"]animations and FX[/url], powers, city design, [url="https://shipofheroes.com/using-character-creation-to-tell-your-story/"]advanced character customization[/url], and many other things. We wanted the game to be beautiful (spoiler – it is) even without movie quality realism. And we wanted a fresh story and setting that explores new ideas, literally and philosophically far away from the Earth we all know. Finally, we concluded that adding chat moderation would suppress trollish behavior, but might also reduce the number of players willing to pay for a new game. So be it. We would rather have a smaller but nicer community.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/7eb12dec8f65a3be0712c33d6668ee38a69c2a5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]While most of the game can be played solo\[missions or combat link], [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] enables [url="https://shipofheroes.com/massively-multiplayer/"]teams of up to 10 players[/url] and raids with league sizes as low as 8, with a current max of 50 - and that number could go higher! This means if you are one of the players who asked for a 10 man raid, not only do we give it to you, but most of the regular content can be converted into 10 man raids by recruiting friends. You'll face bigger and tougher enemy groups, but the rewards will increase as well.[/p][p][/p][p]We also learned that players are deservedly angry and suspicious of AAA monetization methods. So, we have a simple model: pay for the download once, and pay the monthly subscription. That’s it. There is no cash shop, no pay-to-win stat boosters, and no banned-in-the-EU RNG lootboxes. Not now, and not waiting to be turned on a month after launch.  We have big plans for expansions, which will all be offered at no extra charge for at least the next two years. And it's hard to predict the distant future, but we fully expect to maintain our revenue model indefinitely.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Ship of Heroes[/i] is a very [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z1oYNEmLTJ4&t=2s"]beautiful game[/url]. The color palette, [url="https://shipofheroes.com/art-direction-that-fits-the-story/"]art direction[/url], and design all speak to a future that is advancing and improving, and hint at the terrible dangers we face while exploring the vast unknown. But the game is a game, not an interactive movie. Allowing a large number of distinct characters to interact on-screen in interesting ways, all controlled by players online, is more important than having a million calculations for each hair. Better still, you have immense freedom to [url="https://shipofheroes.com/character-creator/"]set your own appearance, costume, and even backstory[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fef19effb217b703b122bd7ea0935dbac4a728c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]SoH delivers a lot of interesting things to do as you explore the game but also respects the player’s time. There is no prescribed content you must get through to reach an exciting end game. Your progression is uniquely yours. In [i]Ship of Heroes[/i], your fun IS the end game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re launching the core of a quality game, so we can interact with our players and expand what's already built in ways that you would like to see. It is a big game with a big story that you can play mostly solo, or on small teams, or in a supergroup, or by joining big leagues. It will launch as a PVE game, and we plan to expand on that base enormously, from entire new worlds to an advanced crafting system. It is just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]Sometime between now and launch, we'll conduct Beta playtests through Steam. Donors who want to participate will receive priority in getting access. Donors at the Deep Pockets level and above will receive first priority in all beta playtests. In the last month before launch, donors at the Beta Testers level and above will receive priority. [url="https://shipofheroes.com/donation-rewards/"]Donations[/url] are still accepted if you want to donate or add to prior donations. To the best of our ability, we will keep or exceed our early promises to our donors. Every donor will be contacted by email in the near future to confirm their donations and rewards, which can also be viewed on the [url="https://shipofheroes.com/donation-rewards/"]Donation Rewards[/url] page.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/90b98f87dcd666238b6aa4f1657dbb88878f64ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sometime before launch, we will publish a free demo on Steam. Watch for the announcement or [u]signup to be notified.[/u] We hope you and your friends come and give it a try.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been looking forward to launch day for a long time, and we are happy to deliver on it.[/p][p][/p][p]This game is the creation of a passionate group of indies, dreamers, and veteran developers. It mixes futuristic soft sci-fi and magic with tales of noble heroes overcoming dangerous villains. Heroes like you.[/p][p]We hope you like it.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: How Animations and FX Make Ship of Heroes Exciting
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="LQxh2d0oHT0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Giant explosions! More seriously, today we'd like to share a few of our favorite animations in Ship of Heroes, and why we think our animations and FX help to make the game exciting. Reviewing and upgrading animations and FX was a major project lasting many months. And no wonder: there are animations for when hero and enemy powers fire, reaction and impact animations for the target, movement animations for heroes, civilians, and enemies including non-humanoid enemies, idle animations so heroes and NPCs do not stand there stiffly, emote animations, and special purpose animations such as dancing in the Beta Club and animations related to NPC roles. Both heroes and some enemies can fight in flight, which greatly increases the number of animations. We have not taken an exact count, but in total, somewhere between 500 and 1000.[/p][p][/p][p]Players often come to love and identify with their favorite combat powers, and with how they look and sound. In this video, you'll see a few of ours, and what makes an animation or FX a good fit for SoH. And you’ll see how some non-combat animations can add to the immersion in the game as well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e31d4769efef0fe6e61dd09d5387f58733fd7f29.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the key considerations in a superhero game like Ship of Heroes is that the animations should look, well, superpowered. For us, this means that they should look [b]smooth, powerful, and plausible[/b]. And what’s plausible in a setting like ours, with advanced gadgets, improved genetics, and magic? Quite a lot! But it’s not exactly the same for every hero, much less for enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a9eb5dd9cd4e093137edf9376df968a587d897fd.png"][/img][/p][p]Animations that illustrate superhuman physical prowess, magic, psychic powers, futuristic technology, or unusual biology are all very helpful in conveying the superhero themes of the game. FX also help to carry this idea, not to mention being fun to look at. This is one reason why Ship of Heroes is a fairly large game to install – at launch, you'll see over 270 distinct powers of all kinds, with a very large number of polished and distinctive combat animations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/87f2a8571149c0a24561c285484e3802a1420587.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll also see heroes flying, running faster, and leaping higher in the air than any normal human could. Teleporting to key locations, activating spells, using psychic powers, and fighting with futuristic superweapons are all part of the mix. Seeing is believing - and the best part is learning to use those powers with your own unique heroes.[/p][p][/p][p]We look at many features for each animation to see if it is a good animation for its use. Ideally, it should be:[/p][p][/p][p]a.	Fast[/p][p]b.	Strong[/p][p]c.	Weighty, with visible kinetic momentum[/p][p]d.	Smooth, so the character only stops or shifts direction with appropriate timing[/p][p]e.	The FX matches the power's nature: high-tech, or mystical, or psychic, or something else[/p][p]f.	Any weapon attacks use cool weapons that fit the story[/p][p]g.	Footwork is good[/p][p]h.	Posture is good[/p][p][/p][p]Certain features in a superpowered combat animation make the animation good, or great, depending on how they are implemented. For example, a hero’s attacks should usually be faster than a normal human could manage, and if they have a momentum aspect - punches, sword strikes, explosive shots, etc - then the attack needs weight.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/72e27892029fa35b660a2cc0b7c46e7be1cd9ef8.png"][/img][/p][p]Weight is delivered both in the attack, and in the reaction animation. But magical attacks may be different, they may be healing or debuffing oriented, and if so, they should not have much weight to them. Does a laser beam knock an enemy back by 20 feet? Not usually. So, each animation needs to match the power's the underlying story and premise.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/07c7497dbc185220cca5f6b795c1c2bc5da317bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Another factor is smoothness. Ship of Heroes blends animations that overlap, so you can take off into the air while throwing a fireball, and see a motion in between what either action alone would look like. If you're punching and being punched at the same time, your head or shoulders may flinch back in an impact animation, at the same time as your arm moves forward. Flight is even more complex, with movements for ascending, descending, hovering, flying in every direction, etc. And SoH is built to enable aerial combat - you can already encounter a couple of enemies who will attack while flying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/2b2c46863ab805e8d0edd6d2d13c706b90965e69.png"][/img][/p][p]Making foundational animations look good also depends on other parts of the game, like the pathing AI. The NPCs have legs, but do they ever move around outside of cutscenes? After a major battle in the hazard zone, will you find civilians standing in different places and doing different things than before? Do allied combatants ever help out, instead of just standing around? Do they follow you to the next enemies when it's appropriate? In Ship of Heroes, the answer to all of these questions is yes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/d102b447d47b2db6a4a4b66cac40c2067b2c2ebe.png"][/img][/p][p]Of course, the ultimate test for any animation or FX is, "Do people like it?" We’ve benefited from a huge amount of feedback from players and testers who like, or don’t like, different animations. Some have even made insightful requests for changes. Others ask for a cool animation similar to something they have seen in another game. Those reference powers and animations are always interesting to consider, too. So,  every animation in Ship of Heroes has a proven audience of people who are every bit as excited as we devs are to play this fun game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a32f52426630ef832318096d90b5303889af073e.png"][/img][/p][p]Some of the highlights from the video that accompanies this newsletter are at these points, but you can choose your own favorites:[/p][p]0:10 -- One of our devs thinks Heat Wave is the best power in the entire Fiery Melee powerset. He says it is just enormously fun to launch.[/p][p]0:47 – Roll Away is a great power.  It’s just over the edge of what a superb human athlete can do today, but this is an example of how melee fighting takes a step up once heroes are more than human.[/p][p]1:36 – Flying superheroes land with style because they are supers![/p][p]1:49 – Challenge is a taunt power that shows one of the innate superpowers of the melee classes – to protect the team by drawing all of the enemies to himself.[/p][p]2:22 The Nagdellian Berserker pre-death animation has him weaken, recover and stumble to his death.[/p][p]02:23 – The Nagdellian Berserker has a huge knockback power that can send dozens of heroes flying![/p][p][/p][h1]Technical Notes:[/h1][p][/p][p]1.	In any MMO, one of the first decisions is how big to make the animation budget. This budget is not money, though there’s one of those, too - it’s measured in how much latency or lag the animations are allowed to cause. The bigger this "budget" is, the easier it is to make animations look awesome. But when there are lots of moving characters on the screen, especially player-controlled heroes with unique animations,, the budget gets divided up into very small pieces for each animation. [/p][p][/p][p]2.	Multiplayer games also have the issue that players located around the world are all interacting, creating additional lag, even with no animations playing. Single player games generally have much less of this kind of distance or network latency, so the animations can cause more lag without making the game feel janky. [/p][p][/p][p]3.	And even with without the additional latency implicit in multiplayer gameplay, everyone has a different PC. So big animation budgets and cool animations usually prevent some people from playing a game smoothly… or at all. Ship of Heroes is designed to be playable without the latest costly hardware, but even better with it.[/p][p][/p][p]4.	As discussed above, animations should match what the character is doing, in several ways. So, animations can certainly be used for more than one power. MMORPG veterans will be familiar with this fact already. We try to ensure that the reassignment makes sense in the story, and that every power has something cool or interesting about it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ed6b6ef216a4a704da2fc6ff2e944b2e97346853.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Art Direction in Ship of Heroes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Z1oYNEmLTJ4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/94baf5d10169ee9c62309c3f3ba0fce2b997d110.png[/img]
[i]Enter the halls of power and make your mark on history.[/i]

Ship of Heroes is an exciting new Sci-Fi MMORPG with beautiful vistas and thoughtful art direction. In today's video, you'll see several of our favorite in-game scenes that highlight the varied visuals of SoH. All scenes are exactly the way players would see them except for the minimized UI. In our video, there are no cinematic cutscenes slowly rendered at movie quality to hide how the game really looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e70ce1d0f52874994860c046aec57a8e009c7813.png[/img]
[i]Meet interesting aliens - and blow up their warships from the inside.[/i]

There are not too many PC MMORPGs where you can join a 50-man raid and rain fire, throw lightning, or blast beams of dark magic on a giant boss together. Or even hold a costume contest with 50 unique costumes in a line. Of those, fewer still can compare to SoH visually. So, in our market niche, we are one of the best looking games available. And our top-notch art direction is a big part of the reason why.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e46dae349e0a1b6a3674aca7c31f3a213416a4a8.png[/img]
[i]A picture is worth a thousand words.[/i]

[b]Art Direction Done Right[/b]

Art direction is about making countless small, aesthetic choices that all need to fit the themes, mood, tone, mechanics, platform, and audience of a game. You want enough consistency that every location, enemy, and UI menu is part of a cohesive whole, and enough change to keep your players entertained. Ship of Heroes delivers on both fronts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/173bbbadfa5b3ac700243776eb72f5108d639ef7.png[/img]
[i]Even old maintenance areas get auto-cleaned in the far future.[/i]

For example, the FHS Justice is over 200 years old. It's been expanded and rebuilt many times, so certain low-priority areas look much older and more worn than the gleaming streets. But both were clearly made by the same species. Alien ships look like they were manufactured by different species, with different thought processes. And cleaning nanites are commonplace, especially in spaceships, so you won't find a lot of trash outside of recent combat zones. In contrast, the temporary mining colony on New California has a functional look and is not as well maintained. Only the teleport pad that the whole colony relies on is more sophisticated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c46256c8547027a6d455d63ac223e153fc5ecf4c.png[/img]
[i]The functional look of the New California mining colony town[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fa1ceb718a17e4e5f7f9b00d939a8cf5a022a6eb.png[/img]
[i]The sophisticated New California teleport pad[/i]

The future on display in SoH is a bright one, full of advancements and wonder. Far away from the influence of Earth, the massive city-ship F.H.S. Justice is clean, beautiful, and prosperous. But a bright light casts the darkest shadows; the ship is also beset by threats, internal and external. As a hero, you'll find yourself in conflict with many groups, for many reasons. Murderous space aliens. Cunning cyborg kidnappers. Secret societies. Gruff mercenaries willing to do dirty deeds for the right price. And the list goes on... The beautiful environments support this story dynamic, showing you what most heroes are fighting for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/7dfa95a1a9af79e77dc026260e396bb3e9ad9de9.png[/img]
[i]Sometimes, you just have to fight bad guys inside a giant plasma cannon, while it's firing.[/i]

SoH can be played on a wide variety of computers. You can focus on FPS or maximize the graphical fidelity of the immersive FX as you prefer. Players get both text and voiced NPC interactions, and can set their own balance for voice volume, music, and sound FX separately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/d402be3089aeadabbcd887775309b114a739cef2.jpg[/img]
[i]The defaults work well, but you have a lot of room to make changes, too.[/i]

But setting the defaults well is also part of good art direction. For example, shadows tend to strain your PC much more than graphical upgrades like antialiasing, or even high-res textures, especially when there are 100 other characters nearby. So, we use selective shadows and strong antialiasing to enable big raids that still look good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/634856c50c5491af1ac5f2b6825ad41f6b60842a.png[/img]
Heroes and skyscrapers alike cast shadows.

Ship of Heroes is easy to learn but challenging to master. Even the UI gives you much more control and many more customization options than usual. You'll end up combining many combat powers, utility powers like flight, consumable items, info about your teammates, positioning, and more. In a way, it's almost like a grand strategy game. Our professional art direction keeps the screen looking nice even on the hardest difficulties, where you'll need to track a lot of information to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/2d816b71b88cde6f8157a62e39687e304dfd2fe4.png[/img]
[i]All of those pretty icons at the bottom are useful.[/i]

If you've ever wanted to explore a completely new and innovative MMORPG, discover secrets no one else has found yet, and be able to say: “I was playing the day the game launched,” be sure to wishlist Ship of Heroes on Steam.

[h1]Technical Notes[/h1]
1.	SoH has made a commitment to transparency, so we do not publish slick marketing videos with impossible graphics and pretend that they're gameplay. We generally use the current Steam version of the game to produce our cutscenes. And we're proud of how SoH gameplay footage compares to similar in-game videos of other MMORPGs. Even some with much larger budgets don't match up.

2.	Like all smart dev teams working in the Unreal Engine, we use some of the best purchased assets along with our many custom-built ones. However, we almost never use characters, props, buildings or other items right out of the box. They usually aren’t consistent with our art direction – or our polygon standards. Usually, we have to upgrade and alter them substantially before putting them into the game.

3.	Minimizing the UI is not just a dev privilege. Players can minimize the UI by pressing ALT + U or select which UI element you see. Fighting with the UI hidden is harder, though. 

4.	Like most MMORPGs, SoH will look much prettier depending on your computer's CPU, GPU, internet connection speed, and what other programs it's trying to run, plus how busy the servers are. We provide players with significant controls to offset these impacts to some degree.

notes.title: 2024 In Review
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ad42707b5e932002dfe69dd5e8f822f34a2aa134.png[/img]
[i]One of our favorite new costumes created this year![/i]

The biggest news of 2024 has been our announcement that Ship of Heroes will be launching in Q2 2025. All year, we've been preparing the game for launch by adding, improving, and polishing one area after another. So 2024 has been a year of tremendous progress.


[h1]Visual FX get a boost[/h1]

Our attention turned to visual FX and animations first, so we spruced them up to make fights even cooler. The VFX are now more consistent for each powerset, so skilled heroes can tell what kind of powers you’re using at a glance. But our greatest achievement in 2024 with VFX was to individually review every combat effect in the game, one by one, to identify which ones de-served an upgrade. This herculean task has been completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/044c1b88b97e956ba7cfb9a6607a14e8f53be604.png[/img]
[i]That never grows old![/i]


[h1]Comprehensive animation upgrade[/h1]

We also reviewed every combat animation in the game! There are hundreds, and some are subtly different for men and women. After polishing and improving animations for all powers when they're used on the ground, we moved on to in-flight combat animations. Reaction animations were also expanded and improved. Finally, several major enemies like the Berserker got new animations appropriate for their special status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1fd760bf425baf917bb467edda4031f059201290.gif[/img]
[i]Sometimes, playing SoH can feel like you’re in an action movie.[/i]


[h1]Raids upgraded[/h1]

Speaking of big raids, we’ve made major improvements to our raid system. We made these changes based on the answers we received on the raid survey that hundreds of you completed in early 2024. We again thank those of you who took the time to tell us what you found most fun (and not fun) in raids.

We added a sophisticated raid GUI that makes it much easier to organize players into teams. Ship of Heroes enables both small and large raids, and our UI reflects this, accommodating up to 10 teams of up to 10 heroes each, plus a raid leader. Players can be moved from one team to another by the leader. Our sidekicking system temporarily boosts team members to nearly the level of the team or raid leader, so low-level heroes can make a big difference, even on high-level raids. And raids scale up or down with the number of players, so they're easy to form or join, and fun at any size.

The raid leader and team leaders in a raid get some special powers to assist them with managing the raid. They also get enhanced rewards to match the extra work they're doing to make raids fun for everyone else who joins up. 

Individual raids have also seen many improvements, notably the Winter Raid and the Berserker Invasion. Work is ongoing on the New California Raid and the Mothership Raid, and we expect that these two will be added as free expansions after launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e413eebb47c04a3e4ef2fdc89844e68d51605776.png[/img]
[i]Now that’s what I call teamwork![/i]


[h1]All NPC dialog is voiced[/h1]

We've been testing voiced dialog for years now. Despite our limited budget, the result was generally well-received. Now we’ve not only extended voicing to almost all NPCs, but improved overall voice quality as well. So if you'd rather listen to a conversation than read blocks of text, keep the sound on, and enjoy!

For those who think, "What did that guy say just before the fight started?" We’ve also added a new tab to the chat box allowing you to see the NPC dialog that's relevant to you – including conversations your team leader has with mission contacts. Now you can read all of it at your leisure, if you want to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/0502d1a337e0073e2560a6c3c809072aac3eac3c.png[/img]
[i]Conversations are so much more realistic with distinctive voices.
[/i]

[h1]Quality of life changes
[/h1]
Many small but important QoL changes have been made - too many to list them all. But here's a partial summary. We’ve added a mission difficulty slider in General Settings, so that you can modify the enemies you'll face. This is done dynamically, so you'll face big crowds and boss enemies with dangerous attacks more often at higher difficulties, not just the same enemies with x2 health and damage. And the reverse applies if you turn it down to easy. The option is there for a reason, after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png[/img]
[i]Go ahead, crank the difficulty up to max… if you dare.[/i]

As discussed above, the chat has two new tabs, including one to read the dialog of the mission, in case your team moves on too fast for you to absorb it all. We also pulled most of the “drop” notices off of the screen and into a dedicated tab where you can check them at any time, with-out interrupting your concentration during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/517e1f828086b2bd78e4474fda5ddd4e4367fd49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a4373e97b9f013f564ef0a4560c5ca7c2bba0a15.png[/img]
[i]“Am I hoarding a huge pile of loot? Nooo…”- A hero with bulging pockets[/i]

Maps can now zoom out far enough to show either the whole map or most of it, and the majority of GUI elements can be resized independently of each other.


[h1]Character Creator[/h1]

We have continued to add to the character creator with a large Viking-themed costume set for all three body types. Twenty-five new auras are now available for all players to enjoy, in addition to the previous five. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fbe539553114cb60f3e747058622b3777659712a.png[/img]
[i]The fiery aura looks pretty snazzy.[/i]


[h1]Auction House[/h1]

A Beta version of the auction house is working, and it will receive further improvements before launch. But we expect to get a lot of feedback about the auction house after launch, and we'll take requests into account for prioritizing upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9d580d64c73715757f9691a537316dbc3feddaee.png[/img]
[i]Now you too can have a mercantile empire![/i]


[h1]Mystery Mission[/h1]

We've added a unique, fairly easy, story-focused mission called Training Mishap that you'll be offered at the end of Character Creation. You can also get it in Apotheosis City later on. Exploring the malfunctioning training area can reveal early hints about a hidden enemy group from a future update, and expand on the lore for an existing enemy group. We won't give away anything too specific... but keep an eye out for hidden areas!

Thank you for continuing to support us this past year. You can look forward to more news from us in the next few months as we get [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] ready to launch. We hope you're as excited as we are!


[h1]Technical Notes[/h1]

1.	We’ve made some improvements to the backend to reduce lag.

2.	We’ve focused a lot on the network processes that communicate between the servers and the client. This extra layer isn't needed for single player and turn-based multiplayer games, but it's very important for true MMORPGs with lots of players.

3.	We're also working on a more sophisticated setup for a test server. In short: it's complicated. But it's getting there.

4.	We’re involved in a major effort to increase our depth of integration with Steam. Each time we do a major test or a public event, we learn more, and make improvements that will make your experience a little bit smoother.

notes.title: Release Window Announced
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=grJmdK5bxTE;full][/previewyoutube]

New MMORPG Ship of Heroes will launch in Q2 2025! Many parts of the game are working and integrated and launch-ready now, so we’re fairly confident about this date. Right now, we’re fixing bugs and filling in the last gaps, which should take 4-6 months. And SoH already includes some exciting features that many modern MMORPGs lack.

Ship of Heroes is a PVE superhero sci-fi MMORPG set in the far future, aboard a generation ship called the FHS Justice, home to Apotheosis City.  The future is bright; humans and friendly aliens have superpowers, advanced technology, and magic. But many dangers lurk in the shadows, and the Justice needs heroes to face them.​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb390c383a53cb3d09aa639cc65d7b7342e9aa00.png[/img]

Create your own, unique hero to play, and write a personal backstory that other heroes can read.  Make friends – and enemies – among the many voiced characters aboard the ship. Play solo or join teams right from the beginning; even at level 1, you can make a difference on high-level superhero teams and in major raids.  Select a handful of powers to rely on out of hundreds, then customize their effects with complex augments.  Craft, buy, and sell powerful items in the auction house. Design your own plush superhero lair, then invite your friends over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bd5b4b8e4d4632cae5d81447b05021e57de30042.jpg[/img]

[b]Five Archetypes, Hundreds of Powers, Ten Character Slots[/b]

Ship of Heroes has five archetypes at launch, plus plans for more later. Each archetype has varied powersets and specific powers. These include unusual combinations of damage at different ranges, defensive powers, healing, buffing, debuffing, pets, mez/status effects, and more. Every hero has the potential to be good at 2 or even 3 things at once. So, it’d be hard to excel in every area, but you’re never locked into a narrow combat role unless you choose to be. And you can create up to ten characters to experiment with different builds.
[list]
[*] [b]Tankers[/b] take hits for the team by using their melee powers to taunt enemies into  attacking them instead of their more fragile teammates. Tankers have offensive powersets and secondary powersets. They do moderate damage and are very tough.
[*] [b]Brawlers [/b]wade into fights and deal large amounts of melee damage to groups of enemies. Brawlers have offensive primaries and defensive secondaries, the reverse of Tanks. They do high damage and are moderately tough.
[*] [b]Devastators[/b] launch powerful range attacks at enemies while remaining out of range of enemy retribution. Devastators have offensive primaries and support secondaries. They do the highest damage and have moderately effective buffs designed to give them the ability to survive short but very intense fights.
[*] [b]Support characters[/b] are quite varied: they heal and buff their teammates from a distance, keeping themselves out of range of powerful enemies. Support characters have support primaries and offensive secondaries. They do moderate damage and are excellent at making their allies more powerful, keeping a team alive.
[*] [b]Controllers [/b]specialize in controlling and manipulating those around them through mesmerization, stuns and other mechanisms. Controller powers are control and status effects,  different from the powers of other  archetypes.[/list]
Locking down a horde of bad guys with a Controller can be very satisfying!

[b]Power Augments – Better than Gear[/b]

In total, different heroes can access over 250 powers. The powers you choose to prioritize can each have up to 7 augments, which can affect that power, other powers, and even give passive boosts for an infinite variety of playstyles.

[b]Everyone Gets Flight and Superspeed from Day 1[/b]

Part of this flexibility is mobility. You can fly anywhere, without relying on mounts or time-limited jetpacks, and run at incredible speeds. And all of these powers are designed to be used in combat. Even some enemies have adapted to heroes’ mobility, whether by flying themselves, or getting long-range weapons, or simply by knocking heroes out of the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/79bcbd21a64f950a9e150124b8a1c8b0cb8d6bbd.png[/img]
[i]Keep an eye out for distant battles[/i]

[b]Create Your Unique Look Independent of Archetype, Powers, or Level[/b]

Have you ever made a cool character, only to lose that look for the only armor with the highest stats? The Ship of Heroes character creator offers an impressive array of cosmetic customizations, letting you “mix and match” costumes in a variety of colors, styles, and body shapes. Your looks are not limited by your archetype, powers, or level, so you have complete design freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a9930bb914ef580ade2506c611dd12b72978f7d7.png[/img]
[i]Express your artistic side, then show it off in a big, beautiful city!
[/i]
At launch, Ship of Heroes will have story-focused missions, challenge missions, task forces designed for teams of heroes, and big raids, all tested by veteran heroes. So, if you find a way to turn yourself inside-out by jumping into the water, take pride – that’s a real accomplishment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f5db518b955df458ae00a159de06046c21a18448.gif[/img]

[b]A Complex and Evolving World[/b]

Influence far-ranging events in a complex world where the voiced NPCs change, learn, and pursue their own goals as you get further in, just like you do. Your journey will take you to many exciting locations, and even to other planets!

[b]Play with your Friends or Make New Ones, or Try the Hardest Content Solo…If You Dare[/b]

Teaming and raiding are incredibly flexible, but neither is required for progression. There’s no minimum team size, and up to ten heroes can team up to do most missions in the game. Raids can handle – and benefit from having – multiple teams. And the difficulty and rewards generally scale to keep things fun across very different group sizes and levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cecf6c8222722aae9ce2a03eb5507b3c75d7b7b8.png[/img]
[i]Some bosses can launch you into another city block, so be careful. Or don’t…[/i]

Finding other players at the right level to join you will never be an issue again with our sidekicking system. When you join a team, your level is automatically raised to one level below the team leader’s until you leave. Or you can join inexperienced teams as a mentor, and you’ll automatically “hold back” by fighting at just above the team leader’s level.

[b]Seasonal Content[/b]

We will have seasonal activities for at least for Halloween and Christmas, and perhaps other times of the year in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb52d1d2393770869efa85fbc4e2e64c16cb018b.png[/img]
[i]Deck the halls, or deck your foes? Why not both?[/i]

[b]A Big Thank You to our Supporters[/b]

To all our supporters, we’re thankful for your patience, and for the support and advice you’ve given us on the way to this point. We all hope to see you in-game when we launch.

[b]Help Spread the Word about Ship of Heroes[/b]

Ship of Heroes is an ambitious project for an indie team of our size. We lack the AAA resources to simply buy tons of visibility. You can help Ship of Heroes succeed by wishlisting it to give us more exposure on Steam, and by letting people in your network know about us. Every dollar we do not have to spend on promotion is a dollar that expands the game just a little bit more.

We will have a technical test next year, during which players will be able to sample Ship of Heroes and help us stress-test our server setup. Until then, you can [url=https://shipofheroes.com/testing-registration/]join our testing team under NDA[/url] and tell us what you think to help us improve the game. We’re very responsive to feedback.

Launch is only the beginning. We plan to steadily expand the game with new stories, new challenges, new foes, and new worlds. A galaxy of adventures awaits!

Learn more at [url=https://shipofheroes.com/]Ship of Heroes.com[/url].

notes.title: October - November 2024 Update
notes.notes:
In the last two months, we have implemented quite a few changes to improve the player’s experience. Some are fun additions; others are Quality of Life improvements. Here is a partial list, as some are too small to mention here.

There is a big new rez platform next to the hospital. You and your fellow heroes will be rezzed there if you die in the city. After you land at a random location on the platform, you will be touched by a beam of energy that will almost make you wish you could die again. Almost…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a99d1be7f2032acc5bf6de047928796f2199bc28.png[/img]

We understand that sometimes, you want to challenge yourself, and other times, you want to do something very easy. Players can now select their level of difficulty between -2 and +3. The default setting is 0. This setting is found in the game menu. If you join a team or raid, your personal setting is overwritten by the team leader ‘s or raid leader’s choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png[/img]

We have been working on raids and using this experience to stress the servers and communications between server and client. We are making successive, incremental changes to improve performance and reduce lag when playing with many characters and NPCs. Our objective is to enable as many players as possible to have a positive experience in our raid. 

As we are testing, we are also keeping an eye on areas we could improve. For example, we have updated the map markers in raids to show the league leader and team leaders in their team color, matching the raid UI color. Team members who are not leaders are only shown for the player’s current team. Your character is marked by a yellow frame around its health bar in the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png[/img]

We are continuing our animation upgrades to include enemies. Nagdellian enemies have now discovered multiple ways to die; they don’t all fall to the ground in the same way. The Berserker, their oversized and intimidating monster, now shows how hard he is to kill with a satisfying death animation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1fd760bf425baf917bb467edda4031f059201290.gif[/img]

We will be testing the Berserker Invasion under NDA. If you are interested in participating, please [url=https://shipofheroes.com/invasion-test-registration-october-19-2024/]register[/url]. You will also need to have signed as a [url=https://shipofheroes.com/testing-registration/]tester under NDA[/url].
In the crafting and trading area, we have added an auction house where players will be able to trade their drops and crafted items. Crafted infusions and augments will be more powerful than those purchased from infusions and augment vendors.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9d580d64c73715757f9691a537316dbc3feddaee.png[/img]

[i]Ship of Heroes[/i] will launch with a tutorial mission and that mission is approaching completion. Many tutorial missions are boring. Ship of Heroes’ tutorial is part of the story and full of surprises in keeping with the rest of the game. Even if you think you do not need a tutorial, we hope you find it enjoyable to play on its own merit.

[b]TECHNICAL NOTES[/b]

•	MMOs have a lot of communications going on between server and client. The larger the number of players and combat NPCs, the greater the number of communications. The multithreaded chat server does not just host chatting between players, it handles most of this communication.

•	Lag can be caused by the speed of the internet connection, other programs sharing this connection, physical distance between the server and the client, or how the communication is setup in the chat server. We are doing our best to eliminate the latter as a cause of lag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e413eebb47c04a3e4ef2fdc89844e68d51605776.png[/img]

notes.title: Visual FX, Animations, and QoL Improvements
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0N-8XLjA0pU;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a general update on how our program of polishing the game is proceeding.  We are currently upgrading the powers visual FX, improving consistency within each powerset. This builds on the ongoing animations upgrade. This video is a sneak peek at the results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c78f144a784531a1301dc79da384ea9a6b2ab71f.png[/img]
[i]Nothing says "Impending doom" quite like a big, flashy circle on the ground.[/i]

At the same time, we've also made quality of life improvements to superspeed, item drop notifications, and the way powers are displayed in the powers and power trainer popup windows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c89188f645ba5acef0f5b0d1ff7163aa010a3235.png[/img]
[i]Team fights can get a little intense...[/i]

There's good news for team players as well. In [i]Ship of Heroes[/i], when your team leader is speaking with a mission contact, you can stand nearby to hear the voice lines. Everyone on the team can read everything in the dialog tab of the chat window, including what the team leader says to the NPCs. So even if you’re just following a team leader along, you can get the whole story of the mission later by reading the dialog tab, at your own speed. Solo players can also see the dialog in the dialog tab.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/82d4a84294200db3185fe4fad94d19257d86c1a7.png[/img]
[i]Ever finish a battle, and then wonder what the bad guy was yapping about? Wonder no more![/i]

Superspeeding is highlighted with a speed lines effect at the edge of the screen. We received feedback that it induced motion sickness in some. You can now toggle off this effect in the General tab of Interface Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f2b3fcebfb5078b281691e40cafaa749ccfcee06.png[/img]
[i]There are many gadgets and enchantments to negate the speed effect, but some heroes think it's cool.[/i]

When a ranged, targeted AOE attack power is on cooldown, the targeting decal is black and white stripes, not red, until the power recharges.  This is to tell the player that he is targeting an area, but that the power is not yet available.  As soon as the power is recharged, the targeting circle turns red, showing that the power is recharged and ready to fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f44bf51de7acffc8673e844fcec898d0239d3294.png[/img]

Testers told us that all this helpful text flashing on the screen was a bit much: locations, warning, drops, gained levels… So, we did something about it. Item drops don't flash on the screen anymore, except for the rarest ones. They are all displayed on the “Drops” tab of the chat window, where you can inspect them after finishing the mission or monitor them while playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/82d4a84294200db3185fe4fad94d19257d86c1a7.png[/img]

The level-up message will still flash with a badge icon, reminding you to visit a power trainer to select an additional power, and/or an augment vendor to equip additional augments when you have empty slots. Power trainers and augment vendors usually work in pairs, and the one you need to see next will waive at you. The power trainer window now clearly displays the names of your primary and secondary powersets, as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e70cb63b674f8548c56b149badae701a6ff8f8fc.png[/img]
[i]Don't forget to pick a few secondary powers by clicking the tab for them. Some are quite strong![/i]

On the powers window viewed by pressing P, we clarified the mysterious meaning of “P”, “S”, and “M”.  “P” means your primary powerset, and “S” means your secondary powerset.  Your primary and secondary powersets are now identified by name. “M” used to be limited to movement powers, but now it contains a variety of universal powers.  We’ve added a row for temporary powers, too, since these can be quite important in mission gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/42acd647396fd8ed53e397cca6a7d21bbd58aeef.png[/img]
[i]Veterans of our many Betas will recognize some of these powers on sight.[/i]

In addition to UI Scaling, more windows can now be individually resized. Players have more flexibility to adapt their UI to their playstyle and screen resolution.

The big map, viewed by pressing M, is bigger and fancier than ever before. Its maximum size has increased, and when zooming out, you can now see the entire map of Apotheosis City. Dragging the map and zooming in bring details into view. The transparency slider lets you monitor the surroundings while getting your bearings.

You can now see other players' catchphrases and hero descriptions, as well as your own. Just click the hero you want to read about, right-click his portrait in the upper-right, and select "Inspect".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/dbcb92adcd170cfa4fc2ecfc7b26f78c20ffa91b.png[/img]
[i]Many people write up little backstories in the CCT for their favorite heroes![/i]

[b]Technical Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] All powers up to level 50 are being upgraded as we plan for future expansions.  Even though the current plan is to launch with powers up to level 20, SoH is built with growth in mind.

[*] The character sheet showing the character catchphrase is not shown here as it is undergoing a makeover.

[*] The new map features are currently implemented only on the Apotheosis City map. We are methodically rolling them out to all other maps.  

[*] The active mission title is green in the mission tracker.  This is important, since you're free to take on multiple missions at the same time, and you'll want to keep track of which one the map is pointing you towards.

[*] As you can tell, our primary focus at the moment is on polishing and perfecting Ship of Heroes for an eventual launch.  If you have ideas you want to share with us, please post your idea in the forums or send them to us on a contact form. [/list]

Wishlist us and signup for opportunities to play at https://shipofheroes.com/
