notes.title: Auras in Ship of Heroes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9_zFq8opN_k;full][/previewyoutube]

The number of auras available has just increased by 500%, going from the original 5 to 30. This video illustrates just a few of the new auras in action.

When we first started showing off the character creator in Ship of Heroes, we promised that we would make it bigger and better as the game evolved.  And we’ve kept that promise – adding standard faces, many, many new costumes, and other features.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ba55706b7bf749d0304d42ede6f5df7898b57e1a.png[/img]
[b][i]The Beta Club is a great place to show off your looks[/i][/b]

There are auras to satisfy every taste. Some are subtle with a gentle movement; others surround the character in a fast moving and wide reaching whirlwind. Combining the aura with a cleverly selected costume can enhance its visual impact and help you tell your character story visually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/965c32c492373c91fd7788c967bdc951f6393ee9.png[/img]
[b][i]"Spectral heroes stalk the city at night... At least, this one does."[/i][/b]

Characters can look good with and without auras.  It all depends on what story you want to tell with each avatar you create.  But having a hero that can appear to be constantly giving fiery bursts, or one that is surrounded by swirling energy particles moving in multiple different patterns can enhance your visual storytelling, or really help your roleplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ddb33ecf008c48dc38b8f4760e5276798a0be2dc.png[/img]
[b][i]"My inner fire is a great help on chilly nights!"[/i][/b]

Maybe you and a couple of buddies want to create characters with the same aura, and a similar look, and role play as a trans-dimensional group that has come to the Justice to help mankind!  There are unlimited possibilities….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ee0e8419173f977a6a8785bcdf6c25e45936bfba.png[/img]
[b][i]Of course, a fiery aura can also look more ominous.[/i][/b]

[h2]Technical Notes[/h2]

1.	Auras are found in the character creator, on the Appearance tab, at the bottom of the Body settings.

2.	Auras have color settings that can be customized. Most have two, the simpler auras have one.

3.	Auras will dissipate a few seconds after you begin to superspeed or fly, then recover when you stop moving quickly.

4.	Auras can be changed in the character creator at any time.

notes.title: Raids in Ship of Heroes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=idFwgbvRktw;full][/previewyoutube]

Joining raids should be fun. Different raids should be accessible throughout the game, not just as end-game content, and they should reward gameplay skills and organizational leadership skills. But raiding is also a social activity, and many of us don’t want to be stressed when we socialize. How do we balance these ideas? We let players decide whether they want to lead a raid and earn extra rewards for accepting the challenges of leadership. If not, you can join a raid and just follow your team leader, blast enemies, heal friends, and chat at times while you do it. Because sometimes you feel like leading, and sometimes you don’t.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e2706ddfea9dbb1efe7b7739dccc406c3ddea53d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png[/img]
[b][i]“The Winter Queen? Not my problem. I am just a healer.”[/i][/b]

We aim to create raids with big, interesting activities that benefit from having lots of players and make it easy to interact with friends. Of course, killing murderous monsters and getting great rewards is also good. Perhaps saving all of mankind, now and again. And having fun while doing it. On most of our raids, you can join your friends with a character of any level. You will then be brought to within one level of the league leader, or sidekicked. Only the harder raids have level requirements.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/622625bbfbb30fae8c1f0a32d19268b9b9edd3e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/75f91e678b7bd698fe87d678554a421be1ff4aeb.png[/img]
[i][b]“There goes my ride. Guess I’ll have to teleport to the Arch, then walk…”[/b][/i]


Raids can be very emotionally engaging, whether they go well... or not. Many players who answered our raid survey are still carrying around anger from events that happened in some raid they did years ago in another game. The best solution is to play SoH and enjoy better raids with nicer people.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a9bda4abb4fb547f5209497bf52a5d54d0aabe50.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png[/img]
[i][b]“Do not try to “solo” giant cyborg dinosaurs. Do I really need to say that?” - Ambassador[/b][/i]

One common source of frustration is when one inattentive player makes a mistake, and the whole raid fails. The only thing worse than this is actually being the unlucky person who causes the whole raid to fail. We’re designing raids that make it quite difficult to be “that guy.” But at the same time, we’re looking for chances for each team to really impact a raid's progress and success. So good performance leads to winning faster, but one mistake won't wipe the raid. We plan to eventually add a couple of really hard raids. But in other raids, a single mistake by one player will not wipe the raid.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9c1e5d5590a79e54d0ca0de3e4dfd8fce7e8199e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cda031e9de6be86f4c82038f7039288892cba655.png[/img]
[i][b]Blasting enemies feels good at any level. [/b][/i]

Our raids accept different team sizes. Difficulty scales to the total number of players in the league, regardless of team structures, and to the level of the leader. As a result, our raids are vastly more accessible and less rigid. The flexibility of team sizes will make it easier to form raid leagues. We are designing early raids to be easier and less demanding than some of the raids we’re developing for higher levels, so people who want a challenge can still find it.  And we’ll be making rapid adjustments to raids as the feedback comes in, just like we've done with missions and powers in previous Betas. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/23d185799fa1481dcaea2ff3205f24ae07366c2a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f8039075899a02065124c5d3ee7d214daed8e264.png[/img]
[i][b]“Are the good guys winning? Should I cheer, or run?” – Confused bystander[/b][/i]


Some survey respondents were interested in very large raids. So, our raids have the potential to be BIG. Huge, even. The minimum number of heroes that can fight a Winter Raid is 30, at least for now. The current maximum is 101, with up to 10 teams, and those numbers might grow even larger in the future. Leading 100 fellow players is quite challenging, so raid leaders get extra powers, plus team leaders to help organize and control the raid. And a level 1 player can both join and contribute to the success of this raid. The era of the big raid has returned - and we did not have to sacrifice graphics to get it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fcf7b6dcbe426d926f7c8585079b698bc663d9b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png[/img]
[i][b]"Now this is my kind of party! Everything's on fire!" - Meltdown[/b][/i]


SoH raids have a place for every archetype and for every level. In the video clip below, you can see the King of Winter being held in place by a controller during one of our tests. Big raid bosses usually can't be disabled or mezzed by status effects all the time, or the raids would be boring. But they can be mezzed periodically, giving everyone else time to heal, move to new positions, or throw their strongest attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/6571e1cf2e6709c40eb1a5678f1e50b4956b6e9c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png[/img]
[i][b]Having a Tanker ready for when the holds wear off is highly recommended.[/b][/i]

Raids conclude with a summary screen of what the raid league achieved and who were the biggest contributors. What is different is that SoH shows contributions other than damage, like heals, buffs, and debuffs. There is really a reason to bring each archetype to a raid, and recognition of their contributions. These features, and keeping the chat positive, will make the entire raid experience much more pleasant.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/d0136ee7fb561c3e1f46ce52fb8acb63d4b3e3ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png[/img]
[i][b]“Ugh, the Brawlers got impaled again. Who has AoE heals ready?”[/b][/i]

For healers and buffers, the raid UI is a critical tool: you can click on any character’s nameplate to target, heal, or buff them through the UI, without needing to find or click them in the large crowd. So, you can focus on who to heal, and not on standing right next to them, as long as you're in the same general area.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c5fd0ffccad06449d6f57dbae3da11864d227050.png[/img]
[i][b]
The silver and gold teams took heavy damage in this raid.[/b][/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/14fed3dcd41ab6cde7f22d5bcc16b6aa0fb7190c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f8039075899a02065124c5d3ee7d214daed8e264.png[/img]
[i][b]They are not called Berserkers because of their positive attitude.[/b][/i]

[h2]Technical Notes:[/h2]
1.	For those wonder how MMOs work behind the scenes, all the information like your current health, your friends list, your team number, your alive/dead status and even your archetype is being networked through a server by our new multi-threaded chat system. 

2.	Loot will be automatically shared, and griefers will not be able to cheat their teammates out of loot by dropping out of the raid.

3.	Each raid is designed so that multiple paths to success are possible, and experimentation will likely uncover options that the dev team never thought of. We look forward to seeing some crazy tactics!

4.	Playing multiple times, and completing it with multiple archetypes, is the best way to develop high expertise in leading that raid. It will also make you a more skilled player in general. What you know about other builds is almost as important as your own build.

notes.title: New Voices Bring the Story to Life
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cmKkRLHZvi4;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Ship of Heroes[/i] has always been a story MMORPG, and in the past, we have published about the [url=https://shipofheroes.com/our-unusual-story/]backstory[/url], [url=https://shipofheroes.com/iris-the-great/]the major characters[/url], [url=https://shipofheroes.com/the-story-and-key-characters/]the setting and the many challenges[/url] that humanity faces in the future.  We decided a few years back that providing character voices for our NPCs was much superior to text-only, which is used in many older MMORPGs.  In fact, quite a few older MMOs now have player-created voice-over plugins, because voicing the story is a widely popular feature in good MMOs. We’re keeping the text and the speech bubbles for those who like them, but the voices convey a lot of nuance.

Our first set of voices for [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] received mixed reviews when we rolled it out a few years ago.   People loved the voice idea, but they wanted some improvements to be made in the voices themselves.  Since that time, we’ve looked at quite a few options.  Today we are announcing that we have replaced the old voices with much superior new voices, giving a real improvement in the quality of the story telling.  We’ve also expanded the total number of spoken lines, and the number of individuals speaking, to improve immersion.

In the video that accompanies this newsletter, you can hear a few of the new voices. Many dev teams wouldn’t actually show a video without explosions or combat, just to illustrate an upgrade in storytelling mechanics.  But we’re really pleased with this upgrade, and we thought we’d share it with you today.

The accompanying video is a scene from the story arc that introduces mages and magic aboard the FHS Justice.  This arc has a lot of politics in it – players get different results and hear different dialog depending upon how they play the arc.  There is also an element of discovery in the arc.  So, the voiced lines give the players clues to what may be going on in the background between the senior mages who lead factions within the magical population of the ship. Again, the voices are important to telling the story in a subtle way.

We think the player-character should have an important role in the story.  If you save the world, when you return to your mission contact, they should say “Great work, you saved the world!”  The voices make this much more real. Voices also help the player understand why they need to save the world in a way the written text struggles to deliver.

In an MMO, other characters matter to the story as well.  In a good story, the other heroes, and the NPCs are doing things while you progress through your challenges.  The voices and dialog help to convey this complexity.  

Hearing the bantering dialog we often put into the game makes the NPCs seem more real. This is another huge advantage of having NPC voices for the dialog.

We’re continuing to polish our content and add features to make [i]Ship of Heroes[/i] even more fun to play.  Stay tuned for more updates in the near future.  And please don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam! It will help us enormously when we launch.

[b]Technical Notes:[/b]

1.	When your team takes a mission from a mission contact, everyone on the team can hear the dialog (not just the team leader) and can see any associated text pop-ups as well.  All of you are getting the mission together, and the voiced discussion, questions and answers, make a lot of difference.

2.	Settings in the menu allow players to select what they hear: sounds, music, voices, or any combination, or none at all.

3.	The hero’s name is written in the text, but not voiced to avoid mispronunciations.

4.	Adding player avatar voices is under consideration for after launch, but we will want to take the pulse of the community before we offer up this kind of upgrade.

notes.title: February 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=OVpmktEHrX8;full][/previewyoutube]
In Ship of Heroes, you can create your character to exactly fit its story, your story. In this update, we create four very different characters and demonstrate how to use just a few of the features in the character creator.

[h1]Physical Appearances, Costumes, and Powers are Independent[/h1]
This gives players complete freedom to create unique avatars. Ship of Heroes’ character creator offers a fantastic degree of customization, especially for an MMORPG. 

Character creation typically starts by selecting one of the 114 presets for the physical appearance: all of them can be used as-is, or massively edited through body morphs that aren't normally accessible to players. Adjustments to the body shape include height, measured in inches or centimeters, shoulder and arm width, body width, musculature, and more…The second character illustrates some of the possibilities, while the last two are mostly recolored. Nothing complicated.

Several hundred costume pieces can be mixed and matched interchangeably and will adjust to fit the unique body you create. They can be recolored as well. They are not locked in sets, though sets are available. All costume options are included in the price of the game.

[h1]Write a Backstory for your Character (optional)[/h1] 
And of course, players can write a short backstory for every character they create; try reading the stories of heroes you see in the game some time. It’s fun! (Link to our unusual story)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fef19effb217b703b122bd7ea0935dbac4a728c1.png[/img]

Let’s look at how the four characters in the example are created.

The first character, Gadaphia, is a cyborg. Her cybernetic implants are similar to those of female Prometheans, but unlike them, she became a cyborg voluntarily.  In the 25th century, people can transform and alter themselves in many ways. Even regrowing limbs isn't much harder than changing clothes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/46aeef83df69f875e5fc620a13547ec563109011.png[/img]

She's proud of her beautiful human eyes and chooses to wear her vision-enhancing cybernetic implant only on one side. She adjusts its color to match her outfit.

Gadaphia decided that only one cybernetic arm would make it hard to get clothes that highlighted her single cybernetic arm but kept her other arm warm. Besides, how could she resist the lure of two gleaming metal arms immune to breakage? Definitely a plus for a dedicated Martial Arts practitioner!
For her lower body, she had to decide between cybernetic feet only, or whole legs. Choosing just the feet would have made it harder to employ her famous kicks. Besides, the lighted legs are so cool, and their color can also be changed on a whim! Getting dressed is greatly simplified, too.

All in all, Gadaphia is very happy with her selection of cybernetics. 

Next is Ryzali, a fierce alien warrior with a savage look. You don’t want to get on his bad side. What side would that be? He's not telling - not before going into attack mode. His build is strong and imposing, thanks to some adjustments to his body morphs, like larger hands and feet. No shoes for this tough dude. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/8ef2abc63195e871beff3a0fcab463634de6c8f3.png[/img]

Another hint at his savagery comes from the bloody scars running over his brown body – the costume has been colored to nearly match his skin, suggesting they are one and the same.

For his head, preset #6 has been edited, starting with a pronounced back tilt of the face. His glowing lavender eyes have been sunken in with the eye depth slider, while his bushy eyebrow have been made as prominent as possible, lowered over his eyes, and given a striking light blond glow. A frown is his default expression.

While a bald crane or a mohawk also would have been effective choices, a wild hair style in red with hints of flaming red completes the fierce look. Pointy ears only emphasize his extra-terrestrial origins.

The next alien is nearly the opposite. Rainbow Angel has a sweet personality and a slightly ethereal quality suggested by her wispy aura. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bed1e79adf8507d1f6141adda9125e33b00e2269.png[/img]

The heart shape of the female #9 preset face was perfect to convey Rainbow Angel’s sweet disposition. All it took was adding ears and recoloring of skin, hair, eyes, eyebrows and lips to create her look. The pink tone of her skin pairs with her soft blue hair and calls for a soft turquoise and yellow-green color palette for her costume. Her delicate, feminine, but impractical silver shoes confirm what we suspected: she does not expect to fight.

Our third alien is also a formidable warrior, but quite different from the scarred one. He is part of a strong and disciplined fighting force whose role is to defend his group. Everything about him says “disciplined,” from his confident posture to his boldly colored breastplate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cf80f8c3c3738eeecc90a1bc48a7a16cd1a20e37.png[/img]

His species is humanoid but characterized by a prominent external spine and the location of key organs in his upper thoracic cage, higher than in humans. 

His helmet protects his face without being too heavy and lets his colorful mohawk stand straight as a sign of bravery: he is not afraid to have his skull bashed. The color of his mohawk advertises the elite force to which he belongs.

This character could be made by replacing the hair style of any preset with the mohawk. It is all about the costume. 
 
We hope these examples inspire you to create your own unique character, or two, or three, or… Whether fanciful or realistic, human or humanoid, you'll be welcome aboard the FHS Justice.

[b]Note[/b]: If all this seems too much, you can see [url=https://youtu.be/4WbQS6m9U0M]how to make a good looking character quickly using presets and randomizers[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/691cd70894d349fd1b9c1d18bb81de7dcd8fff0d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/23f522732fc23b3f992da4ef5d83583d51628389.png[/img]

9 new hair styles have been added for female characters, bringing the number of options to 26. All hair options can be applied to any of the 46 preset female heads available for customization. All hair options can be colorized with two color shades. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fed499993f848708b77595bd83170cc0d3c24dfb.png[/img]

[list]
[*]We optimized the appearance of the city a bit, adding more color, polishing textures in a few spots, and making some visual upgrades in areas that had not received attention in a while.
[*]We have also adjusted the skies and distance views and managed to eke out some moderate but important improvements in FPS. Our goal is to have a game that is enjoyable even if you do not have a top of the line computer and graphics card.
[*]Apotheosis City is getting dressed up for Christmas.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb52d1d2393770869efa85fbc4e2e64c16cb018b.png[/img]

We refined our targeting, following feedback gathered during Steam Next Fest, and [url=https://shipofheroes.com/targeting-upgrades-in-ship-of-heroes/ ]explained how it works in a newsletter.[/url]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Our big map now has a transparency slider. Those who want to keep the big map open can set the transparency to clearly view the game behind it.
[*] We made the key to switch between superspeed effects programmable for those without a numerical pad on their gaming laptop.
[*] Our largest window size was previously 1920 x 1080. We have added 4 larger sizes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/68e96c9b5d06a5937eca5c445fe83c7eef9f4e8d.png[/img]

[h1]Testing[/h1]

Our pool of volunteer testers has almost doubled since our last update, and we are still looking for more testers, as there is a lot to test. [h1]Updates You May Have Missed[/h1]

[h2]Travel Powers [/h2]
https://shipofheroes.com/travel-powers-in-ship-of-heroes/
In Ship of Heroes, you can fly right from the start. Flying is tons of fun, yet very few modern MMORPGs have it. Better yet, flight is only one of three fast-travel powers in Ship of Heroes.

[h2]Power Augments[/h2]
https://shipofheroes.com/power-augments-better-than-gear/ 
Power augments allow players to strengthen specific stats of different powers. They are Ship of Heroes’ version of gear upgrades, but your appearance and build are entirely independent. For example, you can improve the damage, accuracy, or recharge time of any power.

[h2]Targeting upgrades [/h2]
https://shipofheroes.com/targeting-upgrades-in-ship-of-heroes/ 
Targeting enemies in any game always draws a lot of opinions, and there’s a lot of subtlety to it. Tab targeting in particular is complex. You don’t need to worry about it when you’re playing because it’s intuitive to use. But behind this perceived simplicity is a bit of subtlety.

[h2]The New Camera Menu[/h2] 
https://shipofheroes.com/the-new-camera-menu/ 
We’re adding a camera menu to the Interface options, to allow control of how the camera moves and where it is aimed relative to your character. This will accommodate individual preferences.

notes.title: August 2023 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ac6d4a4335bdf1114dfdcd59ef084eed8e92a8f.png[/img]

[h1]New NPCs[/h1]

[list]
[*]We added several new NPC types for the evil cyborg enemy faction, the Prometheans: the purifier, the hottest dude you don’t want to meet, and his counterpart, the mechanic. Why a mechanic? Because doctors object to working on evil cyborgs. 
[*]We also added 7 other unique Promethean NPCs.
[*]Being an engineer on Ship of Heroes is dangerous. That is why we have added 10 new armored engineer NPCs. They work on all 4 branches of Engineering, Life Support, Energy Distribution, Propulsion, and Weapons, defending their fellow engineers and the ship’s equipment. Engineering is one of the two largest departments on the ship.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cab70fad72e15fb3c7089fd3bd82ec94e6d06630.png[/img]

[h1]New Costumes[/h1]

We continue to increase our costume collection. This month, we added 7 new costume pieces:
[list]
[*]The new engineer armor, shoulders, arm bracers, and gloves are available to players for all three body types, male, female and big guy, and can be recolored. Like all our costume pieces, they can be used independently and combined with pieces of other costume sets.
[*]We also added 3 female tops.  These were created by one of our female devs.
[/list]

[h1]Missions[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f41cce2ab834817d18f84ca09be2a0d96bfc9812.png[/img]

[list]
[*]We added a new four-mission arc, and we have been reviewing existing arcs with an eye to planning our next free public event.
[*]We’ve conducted a detailed review of two of our foundational story arcs, in which the entire dev team played the missions through multiple times, checking and polishing.
[/list]

[h1]Powers, Animations, and FX[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ac4f4a86958107c8948bee4f84b2c6eece43a9c2.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Ship of Heroes currently includes 240 powers. We are currently reviewing all our powers’ animations and effects. 
[*]We added unique death animations and FX for Prometheans.  When an evil cyborg created by a fusion of banned technology and dark magic is killed, something special should happen, right? 
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/75288e47446ffb175327bd2fb519e83439507a02.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Different types of sounds can now be individually adjusted or toggled off.  Want to dial down the footsteps, or the sounds of gunfire and explosions?  You got it.
[*]In the mission journal, we made the list of goals collapsible to minimize the size of that window.
[*]When Unobtanium Dust, the in-game currency, drops, the dust count display animates and turns yellow to highlight the drop. The animation also plays when opening the vendor window.
[/list]
